06 / FROM WHEREVER YOU ARE

Your UAE address.
A world of possibilities.

Explore buying in Al Zorah from abroad. A clear starting point for international buyers, with the documents and steps confirmed for your situation.

01

A remote first step

Begin your enquiry and property selection online. Passport details start the process; remote signing or a power of attorney may be required depending on the transaction.

02

A developer payment plan

Payments are spread over the agreed schedule. This is not a mortgage offer. Identity, compliance and source-of-funds documents may still be requested; any financing has separate requirements.

03

Explore residency options

A qualifying real-estate investment totalling AED 2 million or more may support a Golden Visa application. Entry prices shown here are below that threshold. Investor residency and off-plan eligibility require individual assessment and authority approval.

07 / YOUR QUESTIONS

A little clarity
goes a long way.

01

Where is Lorévia Collection?

+

The project is presented in Al Zorah City, Ajman, UAE, in a marina waterfront setting. Al Zorah offers golf, mangroves and coastal leisure facilities.

02

What are the starting prices in AED and USD?

+

Studios start at AED 400,000 (about USD 108,918), one bedroom apartments at AED 800,000 (about USD 217,835), and two bedroom apartments at AED 1,350,000 (about USD 367,597). Prices are subject to availability and confirmation.

03

How does the 5/55/10/30 payment plan work?

+

Pay 5% on booking, 55% during construction and 10% at handover. The final 30% is paid over 30 months after handover, at 1% of the property price per month. For a studio starting at AED 400,000, that is AED 4,000 per month after handover.

04

When is completion expected?

+

The expected handover is Q1 2029, as stated in the sales brief. The signed contract and official developer updates determine the applicable schedule.

05

Can I buy remotely with a passport?

+

You can begin the enquiry remotely. A passport is a starting document, but identity checks, source-of-funds information and other transaction documents may also be required. Confirm the remote signing or power-of-attorney process before booking.

06

Do I need salary slips?

+

The developer payment plan is distinct from a bank mortgage. We cannot promise that no supporting documents will be requested: the developer, bank or authorities may require compliance documents. Financing has its own affordability checks.

07

Does buying a residence qualify me for a Golden Visa?

+

Not automatically. Real estate Golden Visa eligibility generally requires a qualifying total investment of at least AED 2 million and authority approval. The starting prices shown are below that threshold. Ask for an individual assessment, including the conditions for off-plan purchases.

08

Are golf and yacht club memberships included?

+

They are part of the wider destination offer. No membership or access entitlement is promised in the supplied project information; operator terms and charges may apply.
